plan.notes: Official UNK catalog sample 4-year plan for the Biology BS (Department of Biology). Semester subtotals (14/14/14/14/15/16/17/16) and the 120 total match the published plan exactly. Blank cells in the published grid are recorded as labeled General Education/minor/elective choice slots. Chemistry sequences are recorded as combined lecture+laboratory entries at the catalog's published combined credits. Major requires 30 hours with a minimum 2.5 GPA; a minor or second major is required; no more than 2 credit hours of BIOL 421/430/456/475/482 may count toward the major. This is a sample plan; actual course selection and sequence may vary and should be discussed with an academic advisor.
